title: Chislate
description: Ports the Copper Age content from 1.21+ back to 1.20.1. Experience new copper mechanics, blocks, and items in your favorite older version!
body:
The Copper Age Backport brings the beloved copper-themed content from Minecraft 1.21 and beyond into the 1.20.1 environment. This mod carefully recreates the copper mechanics, decorative blocks, and utility items that made the Copper Age update so memorable.

Whether you're building with the new copper variants, experimenting with oxidation mechanics, or just want that fresh copper aesthetic in your 1.20.1 world, this mod has you covered. All content has been faithfully ported and tested for stability.

Perfect for players who love 1.20.1 but don't want to miss out on the copper features from newer versions.
